RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel selecting a man over you — also a man — tells you nothing about sex discrimination in your case. Sex can't plausibly explain why a male panel preferred one man's profile to another's. Raising it would look like grasping, and would weaken the parts of your complaint that are actually strong.

What is worth pursuing: your qualifications look objectively stronger on paper (PhD, nine years in the specific field versus a master's and vaguely described "broad experience of regulatory affairs"). Focus on that mismatch, and on the fact that your request for written reasons has gone unanswered for two weeks. Send a firm follow-up, citing the date of your original request, and ask for the panel's scoring criteria.
